confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from crowdsourced and aggregator Zagreb figures (Numbeo, Expatistan, Deutsche Bank via Croatia Week, travel guides), some dated 2025 or earlier, and are rounded. Cocktail ($8.70) and wine ($5.22) are not directly sourced: they are set at about 2.5x and 1.5x the beer anchor, the local price relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July peak window, not checked against live listings, so they are low confidence. Euro figures were converted at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16, which I did not source. FX is the 2026-10-15 RBA observation (0.6955), taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview page rather than from the page itself. A 2026-10-16 figure (0.6947) appeared only on a third-party site and is not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used for food or drink; those anchors rest on Zagreb-specific aggregator data. Accommodation rests on general knowledge of Central European capital pricing for hostels, guesthouses and three-star hotels in summer.
